prompts.village-life-v10: One ORIGINAL production SPRITE ATLAS for a warm Vietnamese rural village farming game. Exactly 3 columns x 3 rows, nine equal cells, centered objects fully inside each cell with clear transparent margins. No text, no numbers, no dividers. GENUINELY TRANSPARENT background with alpha zero between every object, no cream backdrop or ambient haze. Same coherent detailed bright hand-painted 2.5D isometric cartoon style as a cozy terracotta-roof farmhouse, rounded volumetric forms, warm upper-left sunlight, 26.5-degree ground edges, front and right visible. Row 1 left-to-right: (1) ancient banyan tree, wide leafy deep green canopy, thick twisting trunk, hanging aerial roots, low circular brick bench around base; (2) old Vietnamese village round stone well with wooden posts, small weathered red-tiled roof, rope and bucket; (3) lush tall bamboo clump with gently curved stalks, no fruit. Row 2: (4) broad spreading leafy shade tree with smooth grey-brown trunk, rounded fresh green canopy, no fruit; (5) summer flame tree with airy canopy, orange-red blossom clusters and no fruit; (6) cozy small neighbor cottage with red-tile roof, yellow plaster walls, front porch, clothesline, water jars and tiny flower garden, no people. Row 3: (7) small rural communal pavilion with upturned red-tile roof, open timber posts, benches and small village notice board with blank paper; (8) group of three small white ducks with orange beaks in friendly natural poses, no pond; (9) one friendly small tan village dog sitting beside a small grey cat, both fully visible, no people. Each cell is one separate cutout with only its own small contact shadow and minimal base, no landscape or solid ground tile. Rich original game artwork, no watermark, no existing franchise characters. This is one atlas asset cropped into cells by the game.
prompts.products-v10: ONE original inventory product icon sprite atlas for a cozy Vietnamese farming game. Exactly 4 columns x 3 rows of equal cells, 12 separate items, no overlapping cells, generous transparent spacing and alpha-zero background, no labels or text, no numbers, no watermark. Bright detailed hand-painted 2.5D cartoon objects with warm upper-left light, rounded forms and subtle contact shadows. Row 1: fresh tilapia fish; fresh carp fish distinct golden scales; fluffy yellow baby chick; woven basket of brown chicken eggs. Row 2: small green cloth sack of fish feed pellets with a tiny fish pictogram but no writing; tan cloth sack of chicken grain feed with tiny chicken pictogram; shallow bowl of milled white rice grains; open cloth bag of pale yellow corn flour. Row 3: clear glass bottle of creamy soy milk; glass jar of red tomato sauce with tomato beside; tied bundle of dried fish; bowl of fried rice with egg and vegetables. Every item fully inside its own cell. Rich friendly game artwork matching illustrated rustic farmhouses. Genuinely transparent background, no white/cream rectangular backdrop or haze. Landscape atlas as a single game asset.
